title: Use Seedance 2.5 with up to 50 reference inputs (e.g., product + face) to keep…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 with up to 50 reference inputs (e.g., product + face) to keep the subject consistent across the ad and across frames  
Use Seedance 2.5 frame-level editing/redraw to fix a single broken detail (warped logo/extra finger/flicker) without rerolling the entire shot and losing the good parts
tips:
Use Seedance 2.5 with up to 50 reference inputs (e.g., product + face) to keep the subject consistent across the ad and across frames  
Use Seedance 2.5 frame-level editing/redraw to fix a single broken detail (warped logo/extra finger/flicker) without rerolling the entire shot and losing the good parts

es.content:
Usa Seedance 2.5 con hasta 50 inputs de referencia (p. ej., producto + rostro) para mantener la coherencia del sujeto en todo el anuncio y entre fotogramas  
Usa la edición/redraw a nivel de frame de Seedance 2.5 para corregir un único detalle defectuoso (logo deformado/dedo extra/parpadeo) sin volver a generar toda la toma y perder las partes buenas

fr.content:
Utilisez Seedance 2.5 avec jusqu’à 50 inputs de référence (par ex. produit + visage) pour conserver la cohérence du sujet tout au long de la publicité et d’une frame à l’autre  
Utilisez l’édition/redraw au niveau frame de Seedance 2.5 pour corriger un seul détail défectueux (logo déformé/doigt en trop/flicker) sans relancer toute la prise et perdre les éléments réussis

ja.content:
Seedance 2.5 を使って、最大 50 個の参照入力（例：商品＋顔）を指定し、広告全体および各フレームを通して被写体の一貫性を保つ  
Seedance 2.5 の frame-level editing/redraw を使って、歪んだロゴ／余分な指／ちらつきなどの単一の破綻したディテールを修正し、ショット全体を reroll して良い部分まで失わずに済ませる

ko.content:
Seedance 2.5를 최대 50개의 reference input(예: 제품 + 얼굴)과 함께 사용해 광고 전반과 프레임 간에 subject의 일관성을 유지하세요.  
Seedance 2.5의 frame-level editing/redraw를 사용하면 전체 shot을 다시 생성해 좋은 부분을 잃지 않고도 왜곡된 로고, 여분의 손가락, flicker 같은 단일한 깨진 디테일을 수정할 수 있습니다.

pt.content:
Use o Seedance 2.5 com até 50 inputs de referência (por exemplo, produto + rosto) para manter o sujeito consistente ao longo do anúncio e entre os frames  
Use a edição/redraw em nível de frame do Seedance 2.5 para corrigir um único detalhe quebrado (logo distorcido/dedo extra/flicker) sem refazer toda a tomada e perder as partes boas

zh.content:
使用 Seedance 2.5，最多可输入 50 个参考素材（例如产品 + 人脸），以确保主体在整支广告及各个画面中保持一致  
使用 Seedance 2.5 的逐帧编辑/重绘功能，修复单个损坏细节（如变形的 logo / 多余的手指 / 闪烁），而无需重新生成整个镜头并丢失已有的优质部分
